details.description: Parle Monaco Zeera is a popular savory biscuit snack known for its light, crispy texture and distinctive cumin (zeera) flavor. The product is positioned as a “crispy light salty snack,” making it a convenient choice for quick munching, tea-time, or pairing with toppings like cheese, chutneys, or spreads. Its mild saltiness combined with the aromatic taste of cumin gives it a simple yet appealing flavor profile that is widely enjoyed across age groups. The biscuits are easy to carry and consume on the go, making them a staple in many households for everyday snacking. However, being a processed product made with refined flour, oils, and flavouring agents, it is best consumed in moderation as part of a balanced diet.

details.description: Parle Chatkeens Moong Dal is a simple yet flavorful ready-to-eat savory snack made from crispy fried split moong lentils, offering a crunchy texture and mildly tangy, salty taste. The packaging highlights it as “rich in protein,” appealing to consumers looking for a pulse-based snack option compared to typical namkeens. Its clean, green-themed design emphasizes freshness and the primary ingredient, making it easy to recognize as a lentil-based product. It is convenient for on-the-go snacking, tea-time, or light munching, and can also be used as a topping for chaats or salads to add crunch. While it is comparatively simpler in ingredients than mixed snacks, it is still a fried, processed product, so it is best enjoyed in moderation as part of a balanced diet.

details.description:
Parle’s Cream n’ Onion Wafers come in a packet and weigh 110g. They are made of a delightful and tasty combination of cream and onion with herbs, salt and spices.
The wafers are made of potatoes that are crisp and light in appearance and are enriched with the exotic flavours of cream cheese and onion. It has an energy content of 556 kcal and a protein content of 8.1 g per 100g and is very essential for a fresh and energetic experience.
